details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] The next Festive card that costs 3 or less or Mage card that costs 3 or less you play this turn costs 3 less. Whenever you play a Festive card that costs 3 or less or a Mage card that costs 3 or less, select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage.

issues: The fanfare cost-reduction ability is too broad; `grantNextPlayCostReduction.filter` should restrict to cards that are either Festive and cost 3 or less or Mage and cost 3 or less, not all cards costing 3 or less.

The triggered damage ability is too broad and has the wrong duration/timing placement; it should only trigger when you play a Festive card that costs 3 or less or a Mage card that costs 3 or less, and it should be represented as a continuous/field trigger rather than granted only by fanfare for this turn.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. [fanfare] Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put a follower from among them into your EX area. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you put a follower into your EX area this way, discard a card.

issues: The fanfare incorrectly makes the discard unconditional; the discard should happen only if you put a follower into your EX area this way.
